context_contract.why_serve_is_tighter: `_shared_insert` samples the first token as part of prefill, so `last_token` is the token AT the prompt's last position. `_shared_generate` pushes it to the history and calls forward(last_sampled_token), which consumes a position at or past MAX_L on a prompt that filled the cache. Prefilling succeeded and generation then threw. The prompt was legal by the prefill guard; the refusal happens one stage too late and is not explicit.

kv_model.derivation: PAIRED cache: 4 planes of bf16 at kv_heads*head_dim = 4*256 = 1024 elements each. [K hi, K lo, V hi, V lo] per block_host.hpp:93, so 4 planes x 1024 elems x 2 B = 8192 B. An UNPAIRED cache would be 2 planes x 1024 x 2 = 4096 B (recipes/qwen36moe.py: (8 if paired else 4) * kvw).
kv_model.pairing_reason: the paired route stores each K and V value twice (hi/lo residual pair) so the attention output is computed in FP32 from the pair; this is the validated wide dense Qwen attention geometry (recipes/qwen36moe.py paired_attention: qwen35, hidden 5120, 24/4/256/64)
kv_model.row_layout: off = row*kv_row + (value ? kv_row/2 : 0) -- K in the first 4096 B, V in the second (core.cpp kv_row())
kv_model.staging_duplicate: none: 8192 is the single production row; there is no second copy

addressing_detail.rope_reference: cos/sin(pos * inv_freq[i]) in float64 against the f32 the engine wrote

attention_gate.source: engine-internal accounting, block route, 4000 ids, 16 blocks
attention_gate.model: attention per block = 1.628 ms/position x position + 187 ms   (R^2 = 0.99768, 15 full blocks)
attention_gate.why_it_matters: attention is linear in position while GEMM is linear in BLOCKS, so attention's share grows quadratically in context length: 12.3% at 4K, 21.5% at 8K, 35.1% at 16K
attention_gate.decision: STOP full-context escalation; report attention as the selected next target

max_prefill_len.reason: 8K/16K did not pass the end-to-end gate, so there is no evidence to raise it; the value must follow a validated prefill, not a capacity PASS

default_context_length.note: a context longer than default_context_length is requestable with --ctx-len; the 256K capacity is available without making it the default, and KV at 256K is 32 GiB
default_context_length.recommendation: leave 32768; a 256K default would allocate 32 GiB of KV for every request that asked for it
